# Introduction 

```{python}
#| label: load-data
#| echo: false

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from ovito.io import import_file

pipeline = import_file("data/2026-08-08_Test_MagneticField/test.lammpstrj")

# Iterate through all timesteps

trj = []
for frame in range(pipeline.num_frames):
    data = pipeline.compute(frame)

    # Access global properties
    timestep = data.attributes.get("Timestep", frame)
    cell = data.cell # Simulation box matrices

    # Access atom-wise properties as NumPy arrays
    atom_ids = data.particles.identifiers.array
    positions = data.particles.positions.array
    forces = data.particles["Force"].array

    print(f"Frame {timestep}: Parsed {data.particles.count} atoms.")

    trj.append(
      pd.DataFrame(
        {
          'step': timestep,
          'ids': atom_ids,
          'x': positions[:, 0],
          'y': positions[:, 1],
          'z': positions[:, 2],
          'fx': forces[:, 0],
          'fy': forces[:, 1],
          'fz': forces[:, 2],

        }))

trj = pd.concat(trj)
trj = (
  trj
  .set_index(["ids","step"])
  .sort_index()
)

```

# Plot distance 

```{python}
#| label: load-data
#| echo: false

plt.plot(trj.loc[2].x, trj.loc[2].fx)

plt.show()

```
